# America's Real Doctors

Secure, map-based physician directory connecting patients with verified, independent, and patient-focused doctors.

## Purpose
- Crawlable directory for verified, patient-focused doctors.
- Public pages are the source of truth for SEO and AI discovery.
- JSON-LD, sitemap.xml, and llms.txt are generated from the same content registry.

## Search dimensions
- name, specialty, city, country, language, telehealth, acceptingNewPatients, verification

## Public pages
### core
- [Home](https://americasrealdoctors.com/index.html) — Homepage with discovery map, doctor search, and verification messaging.

### search
- [Explore Map](https://americasrealdoctors.com/pages/explore-map.html) — Interactive doctor discovery map by region.
- [Doctor Search Results](https://americasrealdoctors.com/pages/doctor-search-results.html) — Filterable doctor search results page.

### doctor
- [Doctor Profile](https://americasrealdoctors.com/pages/doctor-profile.html) — Public profile for a verified doctor.
- [Join as a Doctor](https://americasrealdoctors.com/pages/join-as-doctor.html) — Doctor onboarding and verification entry point.
- [Doctor Registration](https://americasrealdoctors.com/pages/doctor-registration.html) — Doctor registration flow with credential submission.
- [Doctor Dashboard](https://americasrealdoctors.com/pages/doctor-dashboard.html) — Doctor account dashboard for verification and profile management.
- [Edit Profile](https://americasrealdoctors.com/pages/edit-profile.html) — Profile editing and status overview.
- [Credential Management](https://americasrealdoctors.com/pages/credential-management.html) — License and credential tracking.

### account
- [Email Verification](https://americasrealdoctors.com/pages/email-verification.html) — Email ownership verification step.
- [2FA Setup](https://americasrealdoctors.com/pages/two-factor-setup.html) — Two-factor authentication setup for doctor and admin accounts.
- [Sign In](https://americasrealdoctors.com/pages/sign-in.html) — Local sign-in page for doctor and admin accounts.
- [Forgot Password](https://americasrealdoctors.com/pages/forgot-password.html) — Password recovery entry point.
- [Account Recovery](https://americasrealdoctors.com/pages/account-recovery.html) — Account recovery workflow and recovery code handling.

### admin
- [Admin Dashboard](https://americasrealdoctors.com/pages/admin-dashboard.html) — Administrative review and moderation dashboard.

## Discovery notes
- Keep HTML crawlable and readable without JavaScript.
- Use schema markup to reinforce the meaning already present in the page text.
- Avoid duplicating page descriptions or directory copy across files; generate shared text from the canonical registry.
- Add new city, specialty, and doctor pages to the registry before publishing.
